# hestiacp_web_domain_redirect (Resource)

Manages an HTTP redirect for a HestiaCP web domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Web domain to redirect.
- `redirect` (String) Target URL to redirect to.

### Optional

- `http_code` (String) HTTP redirect code. Defaults to `301`.
- `user` (String) HestiaCP username. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
